name: task-list
title: Task List
description: An agent's live checklist for a longer job: the live item and up to eleven to do in view, finished items (and groups, members nested) folded into one N done row and the rest into +N more, each fold opening in place, a waiting badge, Subagent progress, and a sticky progress bar.

meta.whenToUse: Show the agent's own checklist above its answer while a job of three or more steps runs, and its end state (done or stopped).
meta.whenNotToUse: What the agent did step by step (MessageActivity), a short static checklist (MessagePlan), or a plan waiting for approval (PlanCard).
